# DRSM (DataReel System Monitor)

> DRSM monitors Linux and Windows hosts with BASH plugins run from cron by bin/drsm_run.sh (locally, over SSH, or from Windows and Linux agent reports) and shows the plain text reports on a PHP dashboard. No database, no daemon. GPLv3.

AI-assisted use: get written management approval under your organization's AI usage policy and use only approved enterprise AI models first. The agent assists people and never acts on its own: one step at a time, each command run or approved by a person, no auto-approve modes. Naming an AI tool is a reference only, not an endorsement. See AGENTS.md "Before you use AI assistance" and https://datareel.com/terms.php.

Configuration is plain KEY=value files (etc/hosts, etc/sites) and config/drsm.php; change those, not the installed code. Plugins print INFO/WARNING/ERROR/UNKNOWN lines and exit 0-3. PHP must stay 7.2 compatible and escape output with h(). Run tests/*.sh after every change. utils/drsm_preflight.sh is a read-only check for installs, upgrades and support.
